label: KarooFireFly (Caponedf fork)
description: Automatic smart bike light control based on time of day and ambient light. Supports ANT+ lights (via Karoo pairing) and Magicshine BLE lights (via Bluetooth). Per-light configuration with protocol-specific modes, time-based and ambient light sensor automation, radar warn flash for rear lights, zone change notifications, and manual override via BonusActions.
releaseNotes:
* Fix: lights connect again on Karoo OS 1.663.2548 (SensorService transaction codes detected at runtime)
* Fork build with its own package id so it installs next to / instead of the upstream app without adb
* Magicshine BLE light support (Hori 1300, EVO 1700)
* Dynamic per-device light mode queries via ANT+
* Per-light profiles with protocol-specific modes
* Radar Warn Flash for rear lights
* Tap-to-configure light detail dialog with test buttons
* Battery and temperature readout for BLE lights
* Live ANT+ connection status
* Improved service stability (foreground service type)
* Zone change notifications with per-light mode details
